reason: The structural candidate list contains source mirrors/indices and the previously rejected Mangal source inside GloBI. Counting those as independent GloBI programmes would violate the frozen independence and finite-family rules.

added_adjudication_class.FAIL_NONINDEPENDENT_OR_NONDATA_SOURCE: Namespace is a mirror/index of another candidate or the previously rejected primary source, or is a template/catalogue rather than an ecological interaction dataset. It cannot contribute to the independent-source count.

provenance_rules: globalbioticinteractions/mangal cannot count because it republishes the first primary source that already failed the frozen Mangal joint gate.
When a GloBI index namespace and its source repository represent the same underlying dataset, count at most one underlying source.
Template/example repositories and literature catalogues are not ecological sampling programmes even if indexed rows pass structural counts.
pass_semantics: PASS_REPLICATED_ECOLOGICAL_INTERACTIONS means only that the source has documented study/site/date or explicit network units sufficient to attempt source-specific reconstruction. It does not mean the source is admitted to turnover analysis.
